item.tib: snyan ngag rgyan gsum gsal ba'i me long gi 'grel pa dpyod ldan dga' ba'i snying nor
item.coloph: de ltar mkhas pa thams cad kyi dga' ston bla na med pa snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa dpyod ldan dga' ba'i snying nor 'di ni/ sa yi brgya' byin bstan 'dzin bon gyi rgyal po dge bshes tsa'i gdung las son pa'i dbon po rin chen dpal bzang pos bka' yis bskul ba dang / gzhan yang rang gi gam du nye bar bcar zhing rig gnas 'di yi phyogs la mos shing ljags kyi dbang po ring du rkyang (brkyang) 'dod pa 'ga'i thugs bzhed dang / gtsang gshen snyan ngag mkhan po'i brgyud pa'i srol bzung zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mdzes pa'i ched du/ kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyi rang lo zhe bzhi pa tud+ha tu ra zhes pa chu mo phag gi lo la/ mdo gam zal mo'i sgang rgyud dre'o shod chen g.yung drung gling gi gdan sar rtsom zhing brtsams shing) / de rjes bsil ldan gangs kyi ra ba gtsang gi gdan sa dar lding ri rgyal rtse nas dmu rgyal gshen gyi bla ma khri rin po che kun dga' phun tshogs dbang gi rgyal po'i (pos)/ snga sor gyi snyan 'grel de ha kyang bsdus drag nas blo chen gyi skyes bu dam pa 'dra yin na ma gtogs go dka' bar 'dug pas/ da slar rang cag bon gyi bstan pa la dgongs pa'i ngos nas shin tu zhib la rgyas pa'i 'grel ba zhig gyis shig pa'i bka' mchid spyi bor rtsal (brtsal) ba la rten (brten)/ rang lo re gsum pa sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta'i lo la shar rdza phyug mo dpal ri'i mdun zhol dga' ldan dar rgyas gling du 'bras ldan zla bar/ shis brjod phyag bya'i dngos po ni zhes pa nas/ skya seng bu lnga dag gi ni/ zhes pa'i bar gyi dper brjod mtha' dag rang blos bskran/ go sla ba rnams tshig nyung ngu dang dka' gnad kun shin tu zhib mor bkrol nas bkod pa yin pas/ snga rtsom gyi 'grel pa de ni me lha la mchod pa 'bul bar mdzod la phyi rtsom 'di dag phyag tu 'chang zhing thugs su rol par mdzod cig zhu ba dang bcas pa'i/ yi ge pa ni rang dbon sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang pos bgyis pa 'dis kyang gnas lnga rig pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring por gnas par gyur cig/
